rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is distributed or covered in visibly separate patches.

example.english: The paint is applied patchily and looks very uneven.
example.traditional: 牆身啲油漆一撻撻咁，睇落好唔均勻。
example.jyutping: coeng4 san1 di1 jau4 cat1 jat1 taat3 taat3 gam3 tai2 lok6 hou2 m4 gwan1 wan4

rows.note: Use this when “patchily” means happening intermittently rather than continuously, such as a signal or service.

example.english: The signal comes through patchily, so it is often hard to hear.
example.traditional: 個訊號斷斷續續咁，成日聽唔清楚。
example.jyutping: go3 seon3 hou6 tyun5 tyun5 zuk6 zuk6 gam3 seng4 jat6 teng1 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when scattered isolated instances or small patches are meant rather than a continuous area.

example.english: A few streetlights were lit patchily along the road.
example.traditional: 沿住條路，零零星星咁有幾盞街燈着住。
example.jyutping: jyun4 zyu6 tiu4 lou6 ling4 ling4 sing1 sing1 gam3 jau5 gei2 zaan2 gaai1 dang1 zoek3 zyu6
